title: Bringing a Healthy Options Card Into Use, and Replacing One
content:
On tiers that require it the card must be activated by the member before it will work, because only the member can confirm that the card reached them. This note sets out the terms on which a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card is brought into use, replaced and re-addressed.

**The activation window.** The member activates the card no later than the last day of the activation window counted from the date the card was posted. The window is the number of calendar days the tier carries, and the date the card was posted is the date the programme record shows for the card's issue. Calendar days are counted from the day after the card was posted, every day of the week counts, a card activated on the final day of the window is activated in time, and full 24-hour periods are never used in place of calendar days.

*Boundary cases.* On a tier whose window is 90 calendar days, a card posted on a given day and activated on the 90th day counted from the day after it was posted is activated in time; the same card activated on the 91st day is outside the window. Weekends and holidays are counted like any other day.

**Where the window passes.** A card not activated inside that window is stopped for safety and a fresh card is posted at no charge; the allowance itself is never lost for want of activation.

**Replacement.** A lost, stolen or damaged card is replaced for the tier's replacement fee and reaches the member in the tier's replacement delivery days, and the balance moves to the new card untouched.

**The card number.** The plan keeps only the last four digits of the card and can never read the full number back to a caller; a member who needs the full number is sent a fresh card rather than told the digits.

**Statement delivery.** A member may change how their statement is delivered at any time, and the change takes effect from the next statement rather than reissuing the last one.
